values.note: 2024 season: $35 a night per site, $500 a month, or $475 a month for a season (May through October 1) paid in advance; 5-month stays get a discount. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split). Payment is due before check-in. No 2025 or 2026 rate card is posted.

values.note: Building with restrooms and showers; Wi-Fi at most sites. A community building with kitchen rents separately.

values.note: 'Over 30 campsites', semi-wooded. Many go to monthly and seasonal campers: the city's 2024-04-15 availability sheet showed 3 (July 1) to 17 (May 15-18) sites open on summer dates.

values.note: Reserve by calling the city (231-839-4561 office, 231-839-4429 field); bookings for a season open April 1 and are taken first come, first served. Payment due before check-in.

note: City of Lake City park on 52 semi-wooded acres at 5547 W. Davis Road, four blocks east of Miltner Beach on Lake Missaukee (inland, not lakefront); playground, ball field, open green space and an 18-hole disc golf course with concrete tee pads. Many sites go to monthly and seasonal campers, so call ahead for a summer weekend. --Claude
summary: City brochure (2024 season) + city posts: $35/night (new; monthly $500, seasonal $475/month), 30-amp/water/sewer at most sites (confirmed), showers, dump, Wi-Fi (confirmed), reserved by phone with the city from April 1 (platform operator -> phone). Season left as stored (year_round false; only the seasonal-rate span May - Oct 1 is published, not an operating season). One rate for everyone, so no resident discount. Nightly share: the city's April 2024 sheet showed 3-17 of 30+ sites open on summer dates, so nightly stays are sold (test 4 passes); a posted nightly rate (test 2 passes). Note trimmed of field restatements.
